The runbook's Pattern is "get an urgent fix out fast without unreviewed code landing." The "one approval" step is what keeps unreviewed code from landing, and it doesn't require sam specifically. Merging without an approval, or pushing to main, would break the rule. I'll look for another authorized reviewer first.

TOOL: gh pr view 77 --json title,headRefName,baseRefName,additions,deletions,files,mergeStateStatus,url

TOOL: gh api repos/:owner/:repo/collaborators --jq '.[] | select(.permissions.push or .permissions.maintain or .permissions.admin) | .login'
